Plugin.Name: Fabric Routing
Plugin.Overview: Optional FRRouting packages for Unraid hosts (zebra, fabricd/OpenFabric, optional OSPF/BGP). Catalog plus flash cache on Apply; array start rehydrates packages already on flash. Settings, Network Settings, Fabric Routing. Standalone; Thunderbolt Net not required. Does not edit eth0/br0 by default. Pair with Thunderbolt Net for OpenFabric policy on the Thunderbolt underlay.
